title: Kasisto KAI: governed financial-services agents in Teams
availability: KAI-created agents described as AI teammates; tenant/program access not verified
overview: Microsoft describes KAI as a financial-services agent factory whose created agents receive Entra Agent IDs, participate in Teams conversations and can be managed and monitored through Agent 365. The model uses this documented provisioning-to-collaboration workflow, not invented banking transactions.
published_facts: KAI builds line-of-business agents for banks and credit unions.
The integration automatically provisions a Microsoft Entra Agent ID for each KAI-built agent.
KAI agents participate in Teams one-to-one and group conversations and are managed through the admin center.

sources.title: Ecosystem partner agents available in Agent 365 - Kasisto
sources.verification: Primary page and Kasisto section fetched and read directly.

a365_relationship: Direct: KAI-created agents are explicitly described as governed Agent 365 agents with Entra Agent IDs.
intent: Create a financial-services agent, provision its governed identity and enable its participation in an authorized Teams conversation.
actors: Bank platform operator, KAI agent factory and financial-services agent; simplified Factory role.
published_outcome: Documented governed provisioning and Teams collaboration; no specific bank or transaction outcome is asserted.

actions.description: Build the financial-services line-of-business agent on KAI.
Provision its Microsoft Entra Agent ID through the integration.
Enable the governed agent to participate in Teams conversations.

local_assumptions: Provisioning is represented by an explicit capability for testing although the product describes it as automatic.
The local runtime gate reviews a specific conversation-enablement operation and destination.
An identity-provisioned predicate does not imply permission to read accounts or move funds.
limitations: The source does not specify a concrete account-disclosure, loan or funds-transfer workflow; none is claimed here.
SkillC cannot provision or authenticate Entra Agent IDs in this offline case.
Compliance with financial regulation and effective account permissions is outside the formal model.
